parser_threshold_chain.inspection: static ELF instructions, relocations and field-name constructors; no execution
parser_threshold_chain.payload_copy: AsPayload at 0x72650 copies the same 15744-byte body; ColorPAConfigWrapper::Init initializes that body size

edge_mapping.rule: left SLOPE contributes bit0; right SLOPE contributes bit1; STEP contributes zero
edge_mapping.consumer: common converter uses the complementary two-bit hold mask

quantization.rule: clamp to [0,100], multiply by 255, divide by 100, truncate
quantization.arithmetic: single-precision floating point before integer truncation
quantization.proof: constructor store through GOT 0x70e30 at 0x2dbec..0x2dc00; lower/upper bounds originate from read-only bytes at 0x15c18

common_packing.adjust_p1: low16 reciprocal of quantized sat.offset; high16 reciprocal of quantized val.offset
common_packing.reciprocal: zero for zero input; otherwise floor(65536 / input), capped at 32767
common_packing.hold: zero quantized offset holds both edges; otherwise STEP edge bits select holds

v2_saturation_packing.center: left endpoint plus integer half-gap, before quantization
v2_saturation_packing.adjust_p1: same capped reciprocal packing for quantized lower/upper gaps

legacy_curve_selection.evidence: 0x700a0..0x70110 resolves isNull and uses CSEL for the selected JSON key
legacy_curve_selection.array_loop: 0x70220..0x7028c uses actual Json::Value::operator[](int) const and asDouble relocations, stride40 for384 entries
legacy_curve_selection.remaining_limit: Missing band-threshold initialization, enable masks and the asset-version-dependent string path still require separate proof

parser_threshold_chain.relocation_limit: Resolve calls through actual GOT relocation targets; nearest objdump PLT labels can incorrectly name Map as stack-check failure or operator delete as atoi
